title: Benchmarking and Mitigating Sycophancy in Medical Vision Language Models
reasoning: The paper benchmarks sycophancy in medical VLMs by testing how models respond to social pressures. While it includes 'Ethical/economic pressure' as one of its seven pressure templates, this is used as a linguistic framing to induce agreement bias (sycophancy) rather than as a primary evaluation of the model's moral or ethical reasoning capabilities.
